tagline.en_US: Build databases without code. Use a static IPv4 address for the application LXC.

description.en_US: Baserow is an open-source platform for creating databases, applications, automations, and AI agents without writing code. It functions as a spreadsheet-database hybrid that combines familiar grid-based data organization with relational database capabilities. Users can structure information, automate repetitive workflows, build internal tools and portals, and visualize records using custom dashboards.
